Independent shocks

Independent-shocks identification goes beyond zero covariance and picks the rotation with the smallest third-order cross-moment objective.

Matlab

Runnable simulated example.

Run from the project folder
  1. Open Matlab in apps/atlas/source/matlab.
  2. Run this method script, for example atlas_recursive_demo.
  3. Run atlas_run_all_method_demos to export every method figure set.
Copy into a fresh folder
  1. Copy atlas_setup.m and this method script.
  2. Copy the helper files in the disclosure below.
  3. Run the method script; it creates diagnostics, all-rotation IRFs, and selected/accepted IRFs.

The ZIP button creates the same folder automatically. If an embedded preview blocks downloads, open this page in a regular browser.
